title: LIVEFORGE — Twitch chat writes the rules | Codex x TwitchCon
description:
Twitch chat invents the next rule. You decide whether it enters the game.

LIVEFORGE turns a viewer’s idea into a playable mechanic with the Codex SDK. In this real production demo, chat proposes a floating wedge that never touches either ledge. The host refines and previews the generated rule, approves that exact version, then jumps on, rides across, and leaps to safety. One click restores the saved world.

Try LIVEFORGE: https://liveforge-iota.vercel.app
Source and run instructions: https://github.com/yadneshSalvi/LIVEFORGE

Real Twitch chat and real Codex generation are shown. Generation, activation and restoration waits are shortened. The preview and live crossings are continuous takes at normal speed. Generated source is validated as bounded literal data before exact-version approval.

Submission demo for the Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon.
